title: Stop Doing This When Merging Onto Highways
hook: Stop merging at highway speeds too early.

script.narration: Stop merging at highway speeds too early.
script.visual_search: car merging on busy highway dashcam view

script.narration: First, never slow down on the on-ramp. Second, do not wait until the very end to match traffic speed. Third, stop relying only on your side mirrors.
script.visual_search: driver checking blind spot car interior

script.narration: Instead, use the entire acceleration lane to match the speed of flowing traffic before easing into the gap. Like if this helped, follow for daily driving tips. Have you ever missed a merge? Comment yes or no.
script.visual_search: car successfully merging smoothly on highway

quality_problems: fact-check: Contradictory advice regarding when to match traffic speed (do not wait until the end vs. use the entire acceleration lane).
